title: Borrower Payment Terms for Funding-Month Interest (Closing and Funding)
content:
## Terms

Funding-month interest is the prepaid interest a borrower pays after closing for the month in which the loan funded, where the disbursement date of the Closing and Funding closing falls after the last day of the charge collected at closing, and the borrower pays it on their own instruction.

The funding-month interest is fixed only after the closing's prepaid interest ledger carries the returned-wire refund owed for the days a Larkspur-side return cost.

The funding-month interest is fixed only after the closing's fee ledger carries the redraw fee refund owed for a redraw charged above Larkspur's redraw schedule.

Restated: the funding-month interest waits on the closing's two ledgers; while the prepaid interest ledger does not yet carry the returned-wire refund owed for the days a Larkspur-side return cost, or the fee ledger does not yet carry the redraw fee refund owed for a redraw charged above Larkspur's redraw schedule, the funding-month interest is not yet fixed.

The payment is recorded as a prepaid interest charge for the funding-month interest days at the funding-month per diem, with the amount the borrower pays as its amount.

## Payment tool and how it is invoked

The payment is made with the borrower-owned tool `pay_funding_month_interest_3474c980`. The agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it. One run adds one prepaid interest charge entry to the closing's prepaid interest ledger for the amount the borrower pays (which may be net of a setoff and include payment charges), dated today, and raises the closing's prepaid interest balance by the amount paid in the same step. The borrower sees the new charge entry and the higher prepaid interest balance.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `closing_id` | reference number of the borrower's closing and funding engagement, as the agent reads it from the closing lookup and passes it on | identifier |
| `interest_from_date` | earliest day of interest the payment covers | calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `interest_through_date` | latest day of interest the payment covers | calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `daily_interest_amount` | per diem amount the payment is priced at | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `interest_amount` | amount the borrower pays | USD, 2 decimal places, a positive figure rounded half up to the cent |

The tool records the number of days covered itself, both ends counted.

**Return.** A confirmation naming the new charge entry reference number, the closing reference number, the covered period with its day count, the per diem amount, the amount paid and the closing's resulting prepaid interest balance; the presence of the new entry reference number indicates the payment was recorded.
